verdict.rationale: Asana publishes an official machine-readable OpenAPI spec in its own GitHub repo, Asana/openapi, covering the REST API (defs/asana_oas.yaml) and app components (defs/app_components_oas.yaml), so it can be downloaded. The probe's 404s at well-known developer-site paths only show the spec isn't hosted there, which is a discoverability gap rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: a discoverable spec URL on developers.asana.com (or a link from the API reference), hands-on or independent confirmation of downloading and using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains the OpenAPI Specification for Asana's APIs
To build (i.e., update) the OpenAPI specifications for the REST API (./defs/asana_oas.yaml) and for app components
